sources_considered.why: A contemporaneous primary regulator record documents allegations of unreliable braking, but not a finding about neural-network capability or Level 5 feasibility.
Read to check the Level 5 terminology. It defines scope but does not evaluate February 2022 vision-only systems.
The March rolling-stop service bulletin is outside the target period, and removal of a programmed behavior would not establish deficient neural cognition.
The March 2022 publication falls outside the target period. Its statement about absent Level 5 deployment would not settle the claimed cause.

evidence_items.explanation: The investigation-opening record documents complaints and an inquiry, not established causes. It does not isolate vision-only neural-network performance or assess the full class of contemporary systems against Level 5 requirements.
